intent: Broaden the faithful loader with low sustained support and restrained chord swells, preserving the centered source's melody, rhythmic identity and complete form.

modelAssistance.reason: A first expanded ensemble needs human judgment of weight, phrasing and spatial usefulness; existing bounded model trials do not qualify a model to decide those matters.
modelAssistance.nextCheckpoint: After the listener reviews the full ensemble, representative phrase and separate ending.

publication: The loader-derived secondary score and complete note ledgers retain Martin Galway credit and GNU GPL v3 under the title-specific loader grant documented in samples/rambo-loader/README.md. Generated audition audio and SID stay local pending listening review. Reusable tools retain MIT separately.
